question: The National Highway Authority of India (NHAI) was operationalised in which year?
solution:
The correct answer is __1995__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• NHAI:__

 __
 
• The National Highways Authority of India or NHAI is an autonomous agency of the Government of India.
 
• It was set up in 1995 under the NHAI Act, 1988..
 
• It is responsible for the management of a network of over 50,000 km of National Highways out of 1,32,499 km in India.
 
• It is a nodal agency of the Ministry of Road Transport and Highways.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• In June 2022, India built 75km of road in under 5 days and set Guinness World Record.
 
• The stretch lies on the NH 53 between Amravati and Akola in Maharashtra.
